correctness.rationale: Pinned full proof computes ad_x on vertex idempotents and arrows and splits arrow space by λ_a=d_source-d_target. Since D_nonzero is invertible, its vertex off-diagonal entries can be eliminated by similarity; the remaining square-zero off-diagonal incidence operator has rank n-κ(F), giving exactly ρ zero-Jordan 2-blocks, n+|E0|-2ρ singleton zero blocks, and h_α semisimple eigenvalue blocks, valid even in char2 and with parallel arrows. Coloring support count and expansion over equality constraints produce the bivariate state sum. For a forest edges are independent, giving q^c(1+(q-1)s+q(q-1)t)^m. Independent q=2 complete 64-element 3-vertex example with two parallel arrows and a third edge confirmed all b2,h frequencies, including cycle collapse. Finite enumeration corroborates symbolic proof.
